<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>كاسيت أكاديمي</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Tajawal:wght@400;500;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#2C374B;
    --gold:#FFC107;
    --gray:#434345;
    --off:#FCFBFB;
    --teal:#2C7A7B;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{height:100%}
  body{
    font-family:'GE SS Two','Tajawal',sans-serif;
    background:var(--navy);
    color:var(--off);
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }

  .hero{
    position:relative;
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    isolation:isolate;
  }
  .hero-bg{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;
    background:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center 28% / cover no-repeat;
    transform:scale(1.02);
  }
  .hero-overlay{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;
    background:
      radial-gradient(130% 80% at 50% 26%, rgba(44,55,75,.18) 0%, rgba(44,55,75,.42) 48%, rgba(30,38,54,.80) 100%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(44,55,75,.42) 0%, rgba(44,55,75,.20) 26%, rgba(38,48,66,.62) 62%, rgba(24,31,45,.95) 100%);
  }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  .nav{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:22px clamp(18px,4vw,54px);
    gap:16px;
  }
  .nav-logo img{height:46px;width:auto;display:block;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35));}
  .nav-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .cta{
    font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;
    color:var(--navy);background:var(--gold);
    border:none;border-radius:999px;
    padding:12px 26px;cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(255,193,7,.30);
    transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }
  .cta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(255,193,7,.42)}
  .lang-pill{
    font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:14px;
    color:var(--off);background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.20);border-radius:999px;
    padding:9px 16px;cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    transition:background .18s ease;
  }
  .lang-pill:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
  .menu{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.20);
    border-radius:12px;width:44px;height:44px;cursor:pointer;
    display:grid;place-items:center;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    transition:background .18s ease;
  }
  .menu:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
  .menu span{display:block;width:20px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);
    border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 var(--gold),0 -6px 0 var(--gold)}

  /* ---------- HERO CONTENT ---------- */
  .hero-content{
    flex:1;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    text-align:center;
    padding:20px clamp(18px,5vw,40px) 10px;
    gap:clamp(20px,3vh,34px);
  }
  .headline{
    font-family:'GE SS Two','Tajawal',sans-serif;
    font-weight:900;line-height:1.28;
    font-size:clamp(30px,5.4vw,62px);
    letter-spacing:-.5px;
    opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);
    animation:rise .9s .1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards;
    text-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  }
  .headline .lower{color:rgba(252,251,251,.92);display:block}
  .headline .lower .dots{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:3px}
  .headline .raise{color:var(--gold);display:block;
    text-shadow:0 4px 34px rgba(255,193,7,.35)}

  /* rotating phrase (no box): "لكل" + changing phrase inline on one line, all gold */
  .phrase-line{
    display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;
    opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);
    animation:rise .9s .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards;
  }
  .phrase-fixed{
    font-family:'GE SS Two','Tajawal',sans-serif;font-weight:900;
    font-size:clamp(26px,4.2vw,50px);color:var(--gold);
    text-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(255,193,7,.28);
  }
  .rotator{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    height:clamp(42px,5.6vw,64px);
    min-width:clamp(170px,26vw,300px);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;
  }
  .rotator .slot{
    position:absolute;inset:0;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;
    font-family:'GE SS Two','Tajawal',sans-serif;font-weight:900;
    font-size:clamp(26px,4.2vw,50px);color:var(--gold);
    white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(255,193,7,.28);
    transform:translateY(110%);opacity:0;
    transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.25,1),opacity .45s ease;
  }
  .rotator .slot.active{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}
  .rotator .slot.exit{transform:translateY(-110%);opacity:0}

  .subtext{
    font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif;font-weight:400;
    font-size:clamp(14px,1.7vw,19px);line-height:1.9;
    color:rgba(252,251,251,.80);max-width:640px;
    opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);
    animation:rise .9s .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards;
  }

  /* ---------- SCROLL CUE (small wave + label) ---------- */
  .scroll-cue{
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:10px;
    opacity:0;animation:fade 1s .8s ease forwards;
  }
  .mini-wave{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:22px}
  .mini-wave i{
    width:3px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:99px;height:5px;
    transform-origin:bottom;animation:eqmini 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .scroll-cue .cue-lbl{
    font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:3px;color:rgba(252,251,251,.42);
  }

  /* ---------- FOOTER WAVE (layered, behind stats) ---------- */
  .footer-zone{position:relative}
  .bg-wave,.bg-wave-back{
    position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:0;
    display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:7px;padding:0 clamp(10px,2vw,30px);
    pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;will-change:transform;
  }
  .bg-wave-back{height:170px;gap:9px;z-index:0}
  .bg-wave{height:150px;z-index:1}
  .bg-wave-back i{
    flex:1;border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;
    background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(255,193,7,.18) 0%, rgba(44,55,75,0) 90%);
  }
  .bg-wave i{
    flex:1;border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;
    background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(255,193,7,.85) 0%, rgba(255,193,7,.32) 45%, rgba(44,55,75,0) 100%);
  }

  /* ---------- STATS BAR ---------- */
  .stats-bar{
    position:relative;z-index:1;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    gap:clamp(14px,2.4vw,30px);flex-wrap:wrap;
    max-width:950px;margin:0 auto clamp(16px,3vh,26px);
    padding:12px clamp(18px,2.4vw,28px);
    background:rgba(44,55,75,.90);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,193,7,.32);
    border-radius:15px;
    backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
    box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(10,14,22,.45);
    opacity:0;animation:rise .9s 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards;
  }
  .bar-divider{width:1px;height:42px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);flex:none}
  .app-promo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
  .app-badge{
    width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;flex:none;
    background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:4px;
    box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  }
  .app-badge img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
  .app-promo .txt{text-align:start;max-width:210px}
  .app-promo .txt b{display:block;font-family:'Tajawal';font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--off);line-height:1.35}
  .app-promo .txt .sub{display:block;font-family:'Tajawal';font-weight:400;font-size:12px;color:rgba(252,251,251,.62);margin-top:2px}
  .stats{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(16px,2.6vw,40px)}
  .stat{text-align:center;position:relative;padding-bottom:11px}
  .stat::after{
    content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:12%;right:12%;height:2px;
    background:var(--gold);border-radius:2px;opacity:.9;
  }
  .stat .num{
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;font-weight:700;
    font-size:clamp(18px,2.2vw,26px);color:var(--gold);line-height:1;
    direction:ltr;
  }
  .stat .num .plus{font-size:.7em;margin-inline-start:1px}
  .stat .lbl{font-family:'Tajawal';font-weight:400;font-size:12.5px;color:rgba(252,251,251,.72);margin-top:6px}
  .stat-sep{width:1px;height:38px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}

  /* ---------- ANIMATIONS ---------- */
  @keyframes rise{to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
  @keyframes fade{to{opacity:1}}
  @keyframes eq{
    0%,100%{height:12px}
    50%{height:calc(12px + var(--peak,.6) * 56px)}
  }
  @keyframes eqmini{
    0%,100%{height:4px}
    50%{height:calc(4px + var(--peak,.6) * 15px)}
  }

  @media (max-width:720px){
    .cta{padding:10px 18px;font-size:13px}
    .lang-pill{padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px}
    .stats-bar{justify-content:center}
    .app-promo{width:100%;justify-content:center;order:2}
    .stats{order:1;width:100%;justify-content:space-around}
    .waveform{height:56px}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
    .headline,.phrase-line,.subtext,.waveform,.stats-bar{opacity:1;transform:none}
    .gold-box .slot.active{transform:none;opacity:1}
  }

  /* ================= REELS SHOWCASE (section 6) ================= */
  .reels{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#212a3d 0%,#2C374B 55%,#242e40 100%);
    padding:clamp(56px,8vh,104px) 0 clamp(64px,9vh,116px);
  }
  .reels::before{  /* soft gold glow behind the featured reel */
    content:'';position:absolute;top:38%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,193,7,.14),transparent 62%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .reels .r-badge{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    font-family:'Tajawal';font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--gold);
    background:rgba(255,193,7,.10);border:1px solid rgba(255,193,7,.38);
    border-radius:999px;padding:8px 18px;margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .reels .r-badge .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--gold)}
  .reels h2{
    font-family:'GE SS Two','Tajawal';font-weight:900;color:var(--off);
    font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,56px);line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.5px;margin:0 16px 14px;
  }
  .reels h2 .g{color:var(--gold)}
  .reels .r-sub{
    font-family:'Tajawal';font-weight:400;color:rgba(252,251,251,.72);
    font-size:clamp(14px,1.8vw,19px);line-height:1.9;
    max-width:660px;margin:0 auto clamp(28px,4vh,50px);padding:0 20px;
  }
  .carousel{position:relative;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
  .track{
    display:flex;gap:clamp(16px,2vw,26px);overflow-x:auto;
    scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
    padding:28px max(calc(50% - 170px),24px);
    scrollbar-width:none;
  }
  .track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .reel-card{
    flex:0 0 auto;width:min(90vw,336px);scroll-snap-align:center;
    display:block;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;
    transform:scale(.85);opacity:.6;filter:saturate(.85);
    transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),opacity .5s,filter .5s,box-shadow .5s;
    box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  }
  .reel-card.is-center{
    transform:scale(1);opacity:1;filter:none;z-index:3;
    box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(255,193,7,.24),0 0 0 2px rgba(255,193,7,.6);
  }
  .reel-card .instagram-media{margin:0 !important;width:100% !important;min-width:0 !important}
  .rc-strip{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
    padding:9px 14px;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid #eee;text-decoration:none;
  }
  .rc-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px}
  .rc-name{font-family:'Tajawal';font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--navy)}
  .car-btn{
    position:absolute;top:calc(50% - 6px);transform:translateY(-50%);
    width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;z-index:6;
    background:rgba(255,193,7,.16);border:1px solid rgba(255,193,7,.55);color:var(--gold);
    display:grid;place-items:center;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    transition:background .2s,transform .2s;
  }
  .car-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,193,7,.30);transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1.06)}
  .car-btn svg{width:22px;height:22px}
  .car-prev{right:6px}
  .car-next{left:6px}
  @media (max-width:760px){
    .car-btn{width:44px;height:44px}
    .car-prev{right:2px} .car-next{left:2px}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="hero">
    <div class="hero-bg"></div>
    <div class="hero-overlay"></div>

    <header class="nav">
      <div class="nav-logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="كاسيت"></div>
      <nav class="nav-actions">
        <button class="cta">ابدأ رحلتك الصوتية</button>
        <button class="lang-pill">JD · ع</button>
        <button class="menu" aria-label="القائمة"><span></span></button>
      </nav>
    </header>

    <main class="hero-content">
      <h1 class="headline">
        <span class="lower">اخفض صوت العالم<span class="dots">...</span></span>
        <span class="raise">وارفع صوت الكاسيت</span>
      </h1>

      <div class="phrase-line">
        <span class="phrase-fixed">لكل</span>
        <span class="rotator" id="box"></span>
      </div>

      <p class="subtext">الأكاديمية الأولى في تدريب التعليق الصوتي، صناعة البودكاست، والإنتاج المرئي.</p>

      <div class="scroll-cue">
        <div class="mini-wave" id="wave" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <span class="cue-lbl">تمرير</span>
      </div>
    </main>

    <div class="footer-zone">
      <div class="bg-wave-back" id="bgwaveBack" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="bg-wave" id="bgwave" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="stats-bar">
        <div class="stats">
          <div class="stat"><div class="num"><span class="val" data-target="5000">0</span><span class="plus">+</span></div><div class="lbl">طالب مسجّل</div></div>
          <div class="stat-sep"></div>
          <div class="stat"><div class="num"><span class="val" data-target="700">0</span><span class="plus">+</span></div><div class="lbl">دورة تدريبية</div></div>
          <div class="stat-sep"></div>
          <div class="stat"><div class="num"><span class="val" data-target="8500">0</span><span class="plus">+</span></div><div class="lbl">ساعة تدريب مباشر</div></div>
        </div>
        <span class="bar-divider"></span>
        <div class="app-promo">
          <div class="app-badge"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="وجيز"></div>
          <div class="txt"><b>شهادة معتمدة من تطبيق وجيز</b><span class="sub">أكبر منصة صوتية بالشرق الأوسط</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ SECTION 6 · REELS SHOWCASE ============ -->
  <section class="reels">
    <span class="r-badge"><span class="dot"></span> من الاستوديو مباشرةً</span>
    <h2>أصوات <span class="g">صنعناها معاً</span></h2>
    <p class="r-sub">مقاطع حيّة من ورشنا وأعمال متدربينا ومدربينا على إنستغرام — اسمع الفرق قبل أن تسجّل.</p>
    <div class="carousel">
      <button class="car-btn car-prev" id="reelPrev" aria-label="السابق"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/></svg></button>
      <div class="track" id="reelTrack">
        <div class="reel-card"><blockquote class="instagram-media" data-instgrm-permalink="https://www.instagram.com/p/DYcvgQesju9/" data-instgrm-version="14" style="margin:0;width:100%;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;"></blockquote><a class="rc-strip" href="https://www.instagram.com/p/DYcvgQesju9/?hl=ar" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="rc-stars">★★★★★</span><span class="rc-name">من متدرّبي كاسيت</span></a></div>
        <div class="reel-card"><blockquote class="instagram-media" data-instgrm-permalink="https://www.instagram.com/p/DbGBYbhsHNp/" data-instgrm-version="14" style="margin:0;width:100%;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;"></blockquote><a class="rc-strip" href="https://www.instagram.com/p/DbGBYbhsHNp/?hl=ar" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="rc-stars">★★★★★</span><span class="rc-name">من متدرّبي كاسيت</span></a></div>
        <div class="reel-card"><blockquote class="instagram-media" data-instgrm-permalink="https://www.instagram.com/p/DW6yTEvDMgv/" data-instgrm-version="14" style="margin:0;width:100%;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;"></blockquote><a class="rc-strip" href="https://www.instagram.com/p/DW6yTEvDMgv/?hl=ar" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="rc-stars">★★★★★</span><span class="rc-name">من متدرّبي كاسيت</span></a></div>
        <div class="reel-card"><blockquote class="instagram-media" data-instgrm-permalink="https://www.instagram.com/p/DWCVkWoDPLS/" data-instgrm-version="14" style="margin:0;width:100%;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;"></blockquote><a class="rc-strip" href="https://www.instagram.com/p/DWCVkWoDPLS/?hl=ar" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="rc-stars">★★★★★</span><span class="rc-name">من متدرّبي كاسيت</span></a></div>
        <div class="reel-card"><blockquote class="instagram-media" data-instgrm-permalink="https://www.instagram.com/p/DbYqCDzMLPJ/" data-instgrm-version="14" style="margin:0;width:100%;min-width:0;background:#fff;border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;"></blockquote><a class="rc-strip" href="https://www.instagram.com/p/DbYqCDzMLPJ/?hl=ar" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="rc-stars">★★★★★</span><span class="rc-name">من متدرّبي كاسيت</span></a></div>
      </div>
      <button class="car-btn car-next" id="reelNext" aria-label="التالي"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </section>

<script>
  // ----- rotating phrase -----
  const phrases = ["صوتٍ حكاية","نبرةٍ أثر","حرفٍ رسالة","موهبةٍ فرصة","حلمٍ بداية"];
  const box = document.getElementById('box');
  let cur = 0;
  const slots = phrases.map((t,i)=>{
    const s=document.createElement('span');
    s.className='slot'+(i===0?' active':'');
    s.textContent=t;
    box.appendChild(s);
    return s;
  });
  const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
  if(!reduce){
    setInterval(()=>{
      const prev = slots[cur];
      cur = (cur+1)%slots.length;
      const next = slots[cur];
      prev.classList.remove('active');
      prev.classList.add('exit');
      next.classList.remove('exit');
      next.classList.add('active');
      setTimeout(()=>prev.classList.remove('exit'),600);
    },2600);
  }

  // ----- small scroll-cue equalizer -----
  const wave = document.getElementById('wave');
  const MINI = 7;
  for(let i=0;i<MINI;i++){
    const b=document.createElement('i');
    b.style.animationDuration = (0.9 + Math.random()*0.5).toFixed(2)+'s';
    b.style.animationDelay = (-Math.random()*1).toFixed(2)+'s';
    b.style.setProperty('--peak', (0.4 + Math.random()*0.6).toFixed(2));
    wave.appendChild(b);
  }

  // ----- layered waveform behind stats bar (varied random heights) -----
  const bg = document.getElementById('bgwave');
  const bgBack = document.getElementById('bgwaveBack');
  const BG = 60;
  // front (gold) — natural random peaks
  for(let i=0;i<BG;i++){
    const b=document.createElement('i');
    const base = 40 + Math.abs(Math.sin(i*1.7)+Math.sin(i*0.6)) * 46;  // organic
    const h = Math.max(20, Math.min(150, base + (Math.random()*40 - 20)));
    b.style.height = h.toFixed(0)+'px';
    bg.appendChild(b);
  }
  // back (dim navy/gold) — taller, offset, for depth
  if(bgBack){
    for(let i=0;i<BG-4;i++){
      const b=document.createElement('i');
      const h = Math.max(30, Math.min(170, 70 + Math.abs(Math.cos(i*1.3)) * 80 + (Math.random()*30 - 15)));
      b.style.height = h.toFixed(0)+'px';
      bgBack.appendChild(b);
    }
  }
  // subtle scroll interaction (parallax on the two layers)
  if(!reduce){
    let sraf;
    window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
      cancelAnimationFrame(sraf);
      sraf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){
        const y=window.scrollY||0;
        bg.style.transform='translateX('+(y*0.03)+'px)';
        if(bgBack) bgBack.style.transform='translateX('+(-y*0.05)+'px)';
      });
    },{passive:true});
  }

  // ----- animated count-up counters -----
  const fmt = n => Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
  const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat .val');
  const runCounters = () => {
    counters.forEach(el=>{
      const target = +el.dataset.target;
      if(reduce){ el.textContent = fmt(target); return; }
      const dur = 1700; const start = performance.now();
      const step = now => {
        const p = Math.min(1,(now-start)/dur);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1-p,3);      // ease-out cubic
        el.textContent = fmt(target*eased);
        if(p<1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
        else el.textContent = fmt(target);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
  };
  // start after the bar has risen in
  setTimeout(runCounters, reduce ? 0 : 1100);
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var track=document.getElementById('reelTrack'); if(!track) return;
  var cards=[].slice.call(track.querySelectorAll('.reel-card'));
  function centerIndex(){
    var tr=track.getBoundingClientRect(), cx=tr.left+tr.width/2, bi=0, bd=1e9;
    cards.forEach(function(c,i){ var r=c.getBoundingClientRect(); var d=Math.abs(r.left+r.width/2-cx); if(d<bd){bd=d;bi=i;} });
    return bi;
  }
  function update(){ var i=centerIndex(); cards.forEach(function(c,j){ c.classList.toggle('is-center', j===i); }); }
  var raf; track.addEventListener('scroll',function(){ cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf=requestAnimationFrame(update); });
  window.addEventListener('resize',update);
  function go(dir){ var i=centerIndex(); var t=Math.max(0,Math.min(cards.length-1,i+dir)); cards[t].scrollIntoView({inline:'center',block:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'}); }
  document.getElementById('reelPrev').addEventListener('click',function(){ go(-1); });
  document.getElementById('reelNext').addEventListener('click',function(){ go(1); });
  window.addEventListener('load',function(){ setTimeout(function(){ if(cards.length){ cards[Math.floor(cards.length/2)].scrollIntoView({inline:'center',block:'nearest'}); } update(); },600); });
  update();
  var tries=0, t=setInterval(function(){ tries++; if(window.instgrm&&window.instgrm.Embeds){window.instgrm.Embeds.process(); setTimeout(update,500);} if(tries>12) clearInterval(t); },700);
})();
</script>
<script async src="https://www.instagram.com/embed.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
